title: Breaking-Change Detector on 14 Hand-Labeled Cases
subtitle: Python and JavaScript edits applied to a small synthetic repo, each case labeled breaking or not

rows.label: True positive
rows.detail: Removed or renamed function, class or method, added or removed required parameter, JS export removed, JS parameter count changed

rows.label: True negative
rows.detail: Added function, comment-only change, JS added function

rows.label: False positive
rows.detail: Optional parameter added, docstring-only change, body change with the same signature

caption: It caught every planted break and over-flagged three harmless edits. Fourteen hand-picked cases show the detector's shape, not its accuracy on real code.
